module: "River" edit mode of the world editor. This file is a thin wrapper: it loads the generic logic of meshEditor.lua (via dofile), configures it with type = "River" (preferencesName "riverEditor", niceName "River") and re-exposes its editor callbacks. It registers the riverEditMode mode (icon create_river, action map "RiverEditor", edited class River) with the shortcuts Alt + left click (create a river / add a node), copy and paste river properties.
notes: Almost all the behavior comes from meshEditor.lua; the exported fields are direct aliases to meshEditor.xxx_ (nil if meshEditor does not define them).
The same pattern is probably used by the other mesh editors (roads, etc.), but only River is configured here.

onEditorGui.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorGui_: draws the mode's ImGui interface.

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorInspectorHeaderGui_: custom inspector header.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorRegisterPreferences_: declares the river editor's preferences.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorPreferenceValueChanged_: reacts to a preference change.

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorInspectorFieldChanged_: reacts to a field modification in the inspector.

onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged_: axis gizmo alignment change (the spelling "Aligment" is the code's).

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.desc: Alias of meshEditor.onEditorObjectSelectionChanged_: the object selection changed.

deleteNodeAM.desc: Alias of meshEditor.deleteNodeAM: node deletion, intended for the action map.

selectAllNodes.desc: Alias of meshEditor.selectAllNodes: selects all the river's nodes.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called when the editor is initialized. Creates editor.editModes.riverEditMode (onActivate, onUpdate, onToolbar, copy/paste, delete, select all, icon, auxShortcuts) and adds the auxiliary shortcuts "Create river / Add node" (LMB + Alt), "Copy river properties" and "Paste river properties".

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; only writes "initialized" to the log (level D).
